conditioningLevel.rationale: §7.2 COND resolved to `low` on formula evidence at E2 (reference-key-2026-09-05-r4, slot 11).
evidenceSignals: absorbed slip observation: one M1 contributor(s)
thresholdReasoning: COND anchor recorded `low` with confidence `moderate`.
§7 anchors are exclusive: the recorded value means the adjacent band's anchor row was not reached on this evidence.
limitations: Evidence level E2 on formula scope: formula potential, not measured finished-product performance.

weightPotential.rationale: §7.5 WT resolved to `low` at E2 (reference-key-2026-09-05-r4, slot 11).
evidenceSignals: condition 1 - WT is low, not high; and the C2 statement 'Kein Verkleben oder Beschweren' agrees with the formula read rather than contradicting it
weightPotential.derivation: §10.1: `weight_potential` <- WT; the multi-family `moderate` row projects as plain `moderate` and its mandatory counter-signal stays in the trace (§10.1.1).
thresholdReasoning: WT anchor recorded `low` with confidence `moderately_high`.
§7 anchors are exclusive: the recorded value means the adjacent band's anchor row was not reached on this evidence.
limitations: §7.5 records a judgment-call limitation on every fine-hair value derived from this dimension.

persistence.rationale: §7.6 PERS recorded mechanism class `neutral_non_volatile` at E2 (reference-key-2026-09-05-r4, slot 11).
evidenceSignals: §7.6 explicitly refuses volatile_or_water_soluble when a monomeric long-chain quat is the dominant persistent species
persistence.derivation: §10.1: `persistence` <- the PERS mechanism class projected ordinally (volatile_or_water_soluble->low; neutral_non_volatile->moderate; ph_dependent_cationic->moderate; permanent_cationic->high).
thresholdReasoning: The recorded mechanism class `neutral_non_volatile` maps to the ordinal `moderate`.
G11: this is a mechanism ordering, not a duration claim.
limitations: The ordinal states removal mechanism only; it never asserts how long the product stays on hair.

evidenceSignals: manufacturer_hold_level: null (no C1/C2 hold level in the frozen claims)
holdSupport.derivation: §10.1: `hold_support` <- the HOLD 3-state, unchanged and with no `unknown` member (§7.7).
thresholdReasoning: HOLD is a coarse presence read and recorded `none`.
§10: `hold_support` gains no `unknown`, because §7.7's ontology cannot produce one.
limitations: A coarse presence read; it never grades hold strength.

careDirection.rationale: §9 care_direction resolved to `moisture` on the `humectant_led_minimum` row at E2 (reference-key-2026-09-05-r4, slot 11).
evidenceSignals: thin architecture - no L3 leg at all and a single monomeric quat as the L1 leg
thresholdReasoning: §9 recorded `moisture` with confidence `low`.
§9 constraint 3: positioning corroborates a direction but never creates one.
limitations: §9's ceiling caps a formula-only direction at moderate confidence.

repairSupportLevel.rationale: R2 = `none_visible` (E1), conditioning_level = `low`. No qualifying substantive film route (R2 is not `candidate` or `tested`), so the `medium` row is not reached. No exact-product repair evidence at E3+, so the `high` row is not reached.
evidenceSignals: Panthenol r6 is a fibre-mechanics signal, not an R2 route and not a heat route (FS-24)
repairSupportLevel.derivation: §10.3.2: `repair_support_level` <- the fixed ordered rule over [repair_surface_film, conditioning_level, product_evidence].
thresholdReasoning: R2 recorded `none_visible` and conditioning_level `low`, which selects `low`.
§10.3.2 clause 1: a bond claim is not repair support; R3 is invisible to this rule.
limitations: §10.3.2 ceiling: a formula-only value cannot exceed `medium`; `high` requires exact-product E3+ repair evidence.

focus.rationale: detangling qualifies on BOTH prongs - detangling-led C2 positioning ('Leichtkämmspray', 'erleichtert das Kämmen erheblich') with SLIP moderate, and a slip-dominant light architecture (SLIP moderate, COND low, WT low). volume_lightness qualifies (WT low, no persistent film route) and ranks below detangling; it clears the independent-support bar on a distinct weight observation.
focus.derivation: §10.2: qualifying routes are collected beyond baseline conditioning (§10.2.1, permissive reading T13b), then the rank order repair > smoothing > curl_definition > heat_styling > detangling > volume_lightness > shine binds.
thresholdReasoning: Selected primary `detangling` with secondary [volume_lightness].
§10.2 principle 4: official positioning may corroborate a route but never creates one.
limitations: A focus is a statement of distinctive purpose, not an efficacy claim or a measured endpoint.

specialistFunctions.rationale: §13.3 heat binary derived from HEAT trace state `not_claimed` at E0 (reference-key-2026-09-05-r4, slot 11).
evidenceSignals: C2 house-brand page fetched live and actively checked - the claim genuinely does not exist; not a claim_authority_gap
specialistFunctions.derivation: §13.3: claim-led with an L9 formula sanity-check; the production model carries one binary and the four-state evidence detail stays in the trace.
thresholdReasoning: HEAT trace state `not_claimed` yields provides_heat_protection = false.
§13.3: a formula never manufactures a claim, and efficacy is never graded.
limitations: The binary reports what the product is sold as under EU claim law; it is not an efficacy statement (§3.3).

smoothingRoute.rationale: SFR low: no persistent film at any rank. Water phase, Panthenol and a single monomeric long-chain quat only.
smoothingRoute.derivation: §7.4 (T2): the route is typed from the recorded SFR observation plus §6 mechanism evidence; it is never graded and never itself projected as a production column.
thresholdReasoning: Typed as `none` from the recorded mechanism evidence.
§7.4.1's two-observation test gates whether a smoothing route exists at all.
limitations: A route type, not a smoothing score; it carries no humidity or frizz claim (§7.9).

hairThicknessFit.rationale: §10.3 hair_thickness_fit is weight-led; the `low` row yields fine=recommended, medium=recommended, coarse=conditional.
thresholdReasoning: weight_potential `low` selects the corresponding §10.3 row.
§10.3: no second weight-derived field may additionally modify this table.
limitations: Broad product priors, not universal exclusions or efficacy claims; every fine-hair value carries the §7.5 judgment-call limitation.

damageFit.rationale: §10.3 damage_fit read from conditioning_level `low` and repair_surface_film `none_visible`.
damageFit.derivation: §10.3: `damage_fit` <- [conditioning_level, repair_surface_film, bond_flag, product_evidence], with two independent paths to the highly-damaged tier (R14).
thresholdReasoning: The recorded inputs select the §10.3 row yielding healthy=recommended, moderately_damaged=conditional, highly_damaged=caution.
§10.3 (R14): an R3 bond flag alone never qualifies a product for the highly-damaged tier.
limitations: A broad prior for a damage tier, never an efficacy or repair claim.

textureFit.rationale: §10.3 texture_fit is weight-led with the absorbed slip observation as the high-weight modifier; the `low` row yields straight=recommended, wavy=recommended, curly=conditional, coily=caution.
evidenceSignals: absorbed slip observation: one M1 contributor(s)
textureFit.derivation: §10.3: `texture_fit` <- [weight_potential, conditioning_potential.absorbed_slip_observation, hold_route_state]; the table is exhaustive with an explicit `unknown` fallback row.
thresholdReasoning: weight_potential `low` selects the §10.3 texture row.
§10.3: HOLD = meaningful_hold_route does not by itself raise curly/coily.
limitations: A broad prior per texture family, not a per-user prediction.
